notes.title: Sandwalkers Prologue Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello!

Just a quick message because we just released a hotfix! This should fix a lot of translation issues that were present in the game showing you translation keys (something like [i]<qftue_quest_description>[/i])

Also, we're aware on some issues with bigger screens/Ultra wide. First of all, know that you can skip cinematics by holding the left mouse buttons (the info might be hidden in those resolutions).
You can also end up locked on the fragments stones, because there's a red cross on the top right corner to close this screen. For now the best solution until we fix it would be to play in windowed mode, in a 16/9 ratio resolution (1920*1080 for exemple)
We're sorry about that and will definitely fix it for the EA!

And, last but not least, thank you all for your can reviews and your reports on the forums, that definitely help us fine tuning!

Cheers,
~Thomas
